name: FRAGCOORD
doc: Coordinate of pixel center. In screen space. xy specifies position in viewport. Upper-left of the viewport is the origin, (0.0, 0.0).

name: UV
doc: UV from the vertex() function. This is set to sample all of a source texture.

name: MODULATE
doc: MODULATE color passed in by RenderingServer API.

name: COLOR0
doc: Output color to be blended with the DrawableTexture target. Initialized to (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0).

name: COLOR1
doc: Output color to be blended with an extra DrawableTexture target. Initialized to (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0).

name: COLOR2
doc: Output color to be blended with an extra DrawableTexture target. Initialized to (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0).

name: COLOR3
doc: Output color to be blended with an extra DrawableTexture target. Initialized to (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0).
